title: Feature table
doc: Indexes the files, detects the features of each, aligns them and writes the table as CSV: the chain of `mzlab-cli features` as one step.

source.title: Vendor files or mzML, one series

title: MS2 spectra from mzML
doc: Reads the MS2 scans of data-dependent runs and writes them as spectra with precursor m/z and intensity, charge, RT and scan number; given a feature table it keeps the scans of its features and names each spectrum with the feature id.

features.title: Feature table: keep the scans of its features

min_intensity.title: Peak threshold
min_intensity.description: Peaks below this intensity are dropped; a scan left with no peak is dropped

max_isolation.title: Largest isolation window
max_isolation.description: Scans whose isolation window is wider are dropped; off when absent, and a scan that does not say its window is kept

tol_da.title: Precursor tolerance
tol_da.description: With a feature table: largest distance between the precursor and the m/z of the feature

rt_tol.title: RT tolerance
rt_tol.description: With a feature table: largest distance between the scan and the RT of the feature

title: MSn fragmentation graph
doc: Merges the MSn spectra of an infusion into one graph of ions and neutral losses, with the sub-formulas of the fragments when the ion of the root is given. It proposes candidates; it does not identify.

formula.title: Ion of the root
formula.description: C13H25N4O3S+, C13H24N4O3S+H or "C13H24N4O3S [M+H]+"; empty = masses only, no sub-formulas

smiles.title: Structure (SMILES)
smiles.description: Written back in the graph; it does not change the numbers

ppm_formula.title: Sub-formula window
ppm_formula.description: A sub-formula is a candidate of a fragment within this distance of its m/z

mz_basso.title: Low m/z limit
mz_basso.description: Below this m/z the window may widen to the low-mass window

ppm_basso.title: Low-mass window
ppm_basso.description: The wider window, for a candidate with enough evidences

attivazione.title: Activation
attivazione.description: Only the spectra of this activation (cid, hcd, ...); empty = all

isotopi.title: Keep M+1 peaks
isotopi.description: The M+1 peaks of the fragments become nodes with their monoisotopic peak

strutture_nodo.title: Node for the structure cleavages
strutture_nodo.description: Node nK of the graph: adds the key `strutture`, the bonds of the structure whose cleavage gives its m/z (needs the structure); empty = none

ppm_struttura.title: Cleavage window
ppm_struttura.description: Distance of a cleaved piece from the m/z of the node

scelte.title: Chosen formulas
scelte.description: MZ=ION pairs separated by commas: the formula chosen for the node at that m/z

title: Compare algorithms
doc: Runs the wrapped step once per variant on the same inputs and measures how the outputs differ; it does not say which variant is right.

labels.title: Labels of the variants, comma separated, in the order of the inputs

title: Calibrate
doc: Applies imported calibration curves (signal = slope x concentration + intercept) to the signal of the matched rows of the table; concentrations outside the linear range or below zero are flagged. The line is not fitted here.

curves.title: Calibration curves imported as CSV: name, mz, rt, slope, intercept, unit, range_min, range_max, dilution

samples.title: Roles of the files (campioni/1 or campioni/2)

concentrations.title: Concentration of each compound in each sample as CSV

mz_tol.title: m/z tolerance to match a curve to a row

rt_tol.title: RT tolerance to match a curve to a row

signal.title: Signal the curve was made with

kinds.title: Sample types to quantify, comma separated
